## What this letter says
Noah was seen in the Children's Emergency Department. His temperature was 38.5°C. He has a viral infection. He was drinking well and playing when he left the department. Antibiotics are not needed.

## What you need to do
1. See your GP (family doctor) if Noah is not better in 5 days.
2. Noah does not need antibiotics. The letter says they are not needed.

## Dates and medicines
- Noah was seen on 26 September 2026.
- The letter lists no medicines.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- What does "viral infection" mean?
- Why are antibiotics not needed for Noah?
- How will I know if he is "not better"?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.
